description: A plain object with a `type` describing an event (`[Source] Event`). Created with `createAction` and `props<T>()`.
A pure function `(state, action) => newState`. Built with `createReducer(initialState, on(action, handler))`.
A memoized function that reads or derives data from the state tree. Built with `createFeatureSelector` and `createSelector`.
`Store.selectSignal(selector)` returns the selected slice as an Angular signal.
Registers the root reducers. `provideState()` adds feature state, for example in lazy routes.
Classes or functions from `@ngrx/effects` that react to actions with side effects (HTTP, navigation) and dispatch new actions.
